behavior.pwa: Explicit Update and refresh or Later; no forced reload during capture, scoring, playback or listening
behavior.native: First-party public-version manifest, numeric comparison, fixed store destinations and 24-hour per-version dismissal
behavior.privacy: Update request contains no audio, transcript, installed version, device identifier or account information
behavior.manifestPolicy: Only advertise verified public releases, never a test or pending review build
behavior.history: Preserves device-local recordings and summaries; no storage clearing
behavior.migration: Older PWA installations may require closing all app tabs and reopening once; do not uninstall or clear storage

androidTestDownload.signing: Direct APK uses the existing upload signing identity; use Play internal testing to upgrade a Play-signed installation

verification.automated: 174 tests in 22 files; lint, TypeScript and production build pass
verification.browser: Real waiting-worker lifecycle, explicit activation/reload once, Later, listening suppression, retained history and all four UI locales at 320px verified
verification.live: Public entry, JS, CSS, worker, privacy and update manifest match candidate bytes; complete APK download SHA256 verified; isolated real public first-install worker activation, no false prompt, new history and 320px/390px screenshots verified
verification.service: Unchanged gateway process and code, unchanged Caddy; health, CORS204, private404, lesson and previous entry asset checks pass
verification.preservation: Tracked dist-manifest unchanged; previous APK hardlink/hash preserved; old lazy assets retained
verification.limitations: No new physical-phone microphone accuracy or reboot test; native older versions need installation of a prompt-capable build first
